messages.subject: ggplot2 stacked barplot issue
parts:
Hi ,
I was trying to plot stacked barplots across time (binned into 4-5
grps) for two treatments ...with the stacked barplots in each bin side
by side....
I tried to follow the example mentioned on the R mailing list (pasted
below)
https://stat.ethz.ch/pipermail/r-help/2009-January/185517.html

However, I encounter 2 errors.
The binary package for proto does not get loaded .... I tried it
several times and it gives me the same error as follows
library(proto)
Error in rm(.First.lib, envir = myEnv) :
unused argument(s) (envir = myEnv)
Error in library(proto) : .First.lib failed for 'proto'

I think the second error is due to the previous one
qplot(var, value, data = df, fill = factor(row), geom="bar", stat =
+ "identity", facets = ~ yoda)
Error: could not find function "qplot"

Thanks for your time.
Sincerely

Navin


var1 <- data.frame(yoda1=c(3,7), yoda2=c(1,9))
var2 <- data.frame(yoda1=c(8,2), yoda2=c(5,5))
var1$row <- 1:2
var1$var <- "one"
var2$row <- 1:2
var2$var <- "two"
vars <- rbind(var1, var2)

library(reshape)
df <- melt(vars, id = c("var", "row"))
names(df)[3] <- "yoda"
df

library(proto)

library(ggplot2)
qplot(yoda, value, data = df, fill = factor(row), geom="bar", stat =
"identity", facets = ~ var)

qplot(var, value, data = df, fill = factor(row), geom="bar", stat =
"identity", facets = ~ yoda)
qplot(row, value, data = df, fill = yoda, geom="bar", stat =
"identity", facets = ~ var)
